# Two terms that address alike

`Glossary: gls-dupe-two-terms-alike` `DRAFT`

A glossary where two entries slug to one anchor.

## Scope

This fixture only. It exists so `part-id-unique` is exercised where the address is derived from a heading
rather than authored beside a row.

## Terms

### Identity line

The paragraph beneath the H1, naming the type, the id and the status.

### Identity-line

The same address written another way, which is what makes a citation of it reach neither entry.
